profile_text.body:
EPAM Systems is a public company, traded under the ticker EPAM, that describes itself as a software engineering and product development services firm. According to its own site, it has helped customers digitally transform their businesses since 1993 through what it calls a blend of software engineering, design and consulting services. It says its teams of technologists, strategists and designers deliver digital experiences, and that it specializes in 11 industries across 55+ countries and regions. The site also lists office addresses in Bengaluru, Karnataka and Gurugram, Haryana, India.

The material available does not identify any specific AI products from the company. No products, MCP servers, or lawsuits are recorded, and the site text describes only general engineering, design, and consulting services rather than named AI offerings.
